A new, more modern startup animation.

- **New intro.** A warm glow settles in behind the Lounge mark, the mark rises into place, the name tracks in and a thin line fills while your library loads, then everything zooms gently into Home. The old light sweep, spinning logo and pulsing glow are gone, and the intro no longer keeps redrawing while it waits. With Settings › Animations › Reduced it's still a plain fade.
